					Bixby is Samsung’s intelligent voice assistant that can help you find answers, control your device and streamline your tasks. Bixby has received the following upgrades on Galaxy phones with Galaxy AI, enabling it to be a more helpful, context-aware assistant with greater natural language capability:
⦁ General language understanding: Bixby can comprehend natural language, letting you ask freely and casually for what you want — almost like asking a person.
⦁ Device Q&A: Bixby can answer more questions about the actual device it’s built into, helping you figure out how certain settings or functions work or troubleshoot device issues like a device AI agent.
⦁ Open Q&A: Bixby can agentically search the web to find the right answers for you, meaning you can ask more questions on a wider variety of topics.15

Is Galaxy AI safe to use?
						
							
							
						
					
				
				
					Yes, Galaxy AI is safe to use. Samsung’s technology is built with security at its core, integrating both hardware and software protections to ensure that your personal data stays protected. As AI plays a bigger role in daily life, Samsung remains committed to protecting your personal information through strong, layered security. A few of the security measures related to Galaxy AI include:
⦁ On Device Protection: For Galaxy AI data that gets processed on device, the Personal Data Engine ensures that your personal data is gathered and processed safely. Then for extra safety, the data is encrypted and stored within Knox Vault, a powerful hardware-based security system.
⦁ Tailored Controls: Users can decide whether their Galaxy AI data gets processed locally on device or out in the cloud, letting them tailor their privacy settings to their preferences.
⦁ Connected Security: Your connected Galaxy devices monitor each other for potential threats with Knox Matrix Trust Chain technology, adding another level of security for your data.16
